System Architecture Overview

This page describes the high-level architecture of the platform as of Q1 2024.

Components

The system consists of three main services:

  • API Gateway — handles all inbound requests, rate limiting, and authentication
  • Core Service — business logic, data processing
  • Reporting Service — async report generation, PDF export

Data Flow

Requests enter via the API Gateway. Authentication is validated against the Auth Service. Authenticated requests are forwarded to the Core Service. Reports are queued to the Reporting Service via RabbitMQ and processed asynchronously.

Key Decisions

DecisionChosen ApproachReason
Auth strategyJWT + refresh tokensStateless, scalable
Message queueRabbitMQAlready in stack, team familiar
DatabasePostgreSQLStrong ACID guarantees needed

Known Issues

The Reporting Service has a memory leak when processing PDFs larger than 50MB. Tracked in JIRA: ENG-1234. Workaround: restart the service weekly.

# Start all services
docker-compose up -d api-gateway core-service reporting-service
